plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jim Semivan of the CIA, the US spy agency, and others say that psychic phenomena, known as psi or parapsychology, are real. According to Michels, they hold that mind and matter are connected rather than separate, and call this the core truth only loosely tied to UFOs.
